stories.title: Pakistan voert aanvallen uit op buurland Afghanistan, zeker vier doden

en.title: Pakistan carries out attacks on neighboring Afghanistan, at least four dead
en.summary: Pakistan conducted drone and air strikes on ten locations in Afghanistan, with Afghan officials reporting at least four deaths. Pakistan claims it targeted military sites including drone launch and storage facilities.

stories.title: Meta verwijdert satirische video van Roel Maalderink over de ‘gluurbril’: ‘Voor kritiek is blijkbaar geen plaats’

en.title: Meta removes satirical video by Roel Maalderink about the 'spy glasses': 'There is apparently no room for criticism'
en.summary: Meta removed a satirical video in which a Dutch content creator criticized the company's camera glasses. The video creator expressed concerns about the privacy implications of the wearable technology.

stories.title: Meta haalt satirische video Roel Maalderink over camerabril offline

en.title: Meta takes satirical video by Roel Maalderink about camera glasses offline
en.summary: Meta removed a satirical video by a Dutch programmer and digital rights organization that criticized the company's camera glasses by filming Meta employees without their cooperation. Meta cited harassment and intimidation as the reason for removal.

stories.title: Door Trump verbannen Amerikaanse media moeten van rechter weer toegang krijgen tot Witte Huis

en.title: American media banned by Trump must regain access to White House by court order
en.summary: A court has ordered that American media outlets banned from the White House by Trump should be restored access to the building. The ruling addresses restrictions placed on news organizations by the former president.

stories.title: Trump moet verbannen media CNN, MS NOW en Politico weer toelaten tot Witte Huis, oordeelt rechter

en.title: Judge orders Trump to readmit banned media CNN, MS NOW and Politico to White House
en.summary: A federal judge ruled that CNN, MS NOW and Politico must regain access to the White House after President Trump revoked their press credentials. The judge found that proper procedures were not followed in removing the journalists' accreditation.

stories.title: Rechter VS oordeelt dat Witte Huis verbannen media weer moet toelaten

en.title: US judge rules White House must readmit banned media
en.summary: An American judge ordered that CNN, MS NOW and Politico must regain access to the White House after their press credentials were revoked last weekend. The court found that proper procedures were not followed and journalists were denied the opportunity to respond.

stories.title: Trump moet geweerde media van rechter weer toelaten in Witte Huis

en.title: Judge orders Trump to readmit blocked media to White House
en.summary: A federal judge ruled that journalists from CNN, MS Now and Politico must be allowed to return to the White House. President Trump had blocked these outlets, claiming they spread false news.

stories.title: Meta verwijdert satirische video Roel Maalderink over AI-brillen van bedrijf

en.title: Meta removes satirical video by Roel Maalderink about company's AI glasses
en.summary: Meta removed a satirical video created by programmer Roel Maalderink and civil rights organization Bits of Freedom that critiqued the company's AI glasses. Maalderink stated this was the first time one of his videos had been taken down.

stories.title: WK wielrennen worden in 2034 in Groningen en Drenthe gehouden

en.title: UCI Cycling World Championships to be held in Groningen and Drenthe in 2034
en.summary: The cycling world championships will take place in the Dutch provinces of Groningen and Drenthe in 2034, marking the first time the event returns to the Netherlands since 2012.

stories.title: WK wielrennen in 2034 in Groningen en Drenthe, in 2032 in India

en.title: UCI World Cycling Championships in 2034 in Groningen and Drenthe, in 2032 in India
en.summary: The UCI World Cycling Championships will take place in Groningen and Drenthe in 2034, with India hosting the event in 2032.

stories.title: WK wielrennen 2034 naar Groningen en Drenthe, mede door geld uit herstelfonds

en.title: 2034 World Cycling Championship to be held in Groningen and Drenthe, partly funded by recovery fund
en.summary: The UCI announced that the 2034 World Cycling Championships will take place in Groningen and Drenthe. The allocation was supported in part by funding from an earthquake recovery fund.

stories.title: Netherlands to host 2034 world cycling championship in Groningen and Drenthe

en.title: Netherlands to host 2034 world cycling championship in Groningen and Drenthe
en.summary: The Netherlands will host the UCI Road World Championships in 2034, marking the first time the country has hosted the event since 2012.
